annotations.title: Which arrangement lists a surgeon appears on

description:
Find a surgeon by name (Hebrew, forgiving spelling), licence number, specialty or region, and see which insurers' and kupot supplementary plans' arrangement (הסדר) lists they appear on, with each list's date. Absence from a list is never "not in arrangement": some lists are not checked yet. Before surgery the person must confirm with their insurer.
באילו רשימות הסדר מופיע מנתח, עם תאריך כל רשימה. אם לא מופיע, זה לא אומר שאין הסדר.

name.description: Surgeon name in Hebrew, e.g. "כהן משה"

region.description: ירושלים, תל אביב, המרכז, חיפה, הצפון, הדרום, or a city

specialty.description: e.g. אורתופדיה, עיניים, ortho, eyes (see list_topics.surgeon_specialties)
